name: Vespid Dynamics Autonomous Package Delivery Drone APDD-6
product_name: Vespid Dynamics Autonomous Package Delivery Drone APDD-6
description: A cargo drone capable of autonomously delivering packages up to 5 kg across GLMZ using Vespid's Autonomous Navigation Mesh. The APDD-6 navigates urban airspace, avoids obstacles and other aircraft, and delivers payloads to designated GPS coordinates or directly to a recipient identified by neural interface beacon. The drone is weather-resistant, tamper-detecting, and equipped with a cargo bay that can be configured for standard packages, medical supplies, or temperature-controlled pharmaceutical transport.

specifications.recipient identification: GPS coordinates or neural interface beacon

story_hooks: APDD-6 drones have been hijacked in flight and their cargo redirected to unknown recipients — the hijacking exploits a vulnerability in the neural interface beacon system.
An APDD-6 was loaded with an explosive device instead of a package — it delivered itself to the target's door, and the tamper detection that should have flagged the payload was disabled.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, insectoid delivery drone with a rounded central fuselage tapering to a pointed nose cone. Six articulated rotors extend from a hexagonal frame—three forward-mounted, three aft. The design evokes a wasp or hornet: aggressive, purposeful, built for speed through urban airspace.
physical_description.dimensions: 48 cm wingspan, 32 cm fuselage length, 18 cm height. Cargo bay occupies the ventral fuselage: 30×20×15 cm.
physical_description.weight_description: 3 kg empty, 8 kg loaded. Light enough for one-handed manipulation during inspection, but requires stabilizing straps or a mounting cradle for transport.
physical_description.primary_material: Carbon-fiber composite frame with thermoformed polycarbonate cargo pod. Aluminum motor housings anodized for corrosion resistance.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal composite with satin-finish aluminum accents. Anti-reflective coating on camera lenses. Cargo bay has a subtle texture to enhance grip during loading.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with electric cyan accent striping along rotor mounts and cargo bay edges. Vespid Dynamics logo in cyan on both sides of fuselage.
physical_description.interface_elements: Minimalist design: small 2-inch e-ink status display on starboard fuselage showing battery %, delivery progress, and beacon lock. Cargo bay secured by a pressure-sensitive latch with tactile feedback. Four indicator LEDs (cyan, amber, red, green) clustered near the nosecone. USB-C rapid charge port recessed on port side. Neural interface beacon receiver housed behind translucent sapphire panel on dorsal surface.
distinctive_features: Hexagonal rotor array with counter-rotating pairs for stability in urban wind corridors
Reinforced cargo pod with transparent inspection window (10 cm diameter) for recipient verification
Aerodynamic nose cone with integrated LIDAR sensor array creating a subtle angular profile
Six small ventilation slots along the fuselage for thermal management during long flights
Retractable landing gear (three points) that fold flush with the fuselage when airborne
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS logo (stylized wasp silhouette) in 2 cm metallic cyan on both sides. Regulatory stamp (GLMZ Airspace Authority, 2226) on starboard rear quarter. Model designation APDD-6 laser-etched on fuselage. Small QR code for firmware version below the e-ink display.
physical_description.condition_typical: In active delivery, the drone hovers at 40–60 meters altitude. LED indicators pulse cyan (navigation lock), and the status display cycles through GPS coordinates. After delivery, users often see scuff marks on the rotor guards and minor polymer stress marks on the cargo bay from repeated pressurization cycles.

image_prompt: Product photography: Vespid Dynamics APDD-6 delivery drone positioned on a sleek aluminum workbench in a neo-noir loft. Drone angled three-quarter view, rotors extended and ready. Dramatic side-lighting casts sharp shadows across the carbon-fiber composite fuselage, highlighting the matte charcoal finish and electric cyan accent striping. The transparent cargo bay window glows faintly with internal blue LEDs. In soft focus behind: a holographic shipping manifest displayed on a wall-mounted terminal. Moody neon-blue and amber overhead lighting reflects off the polished workbench surface. Shallow depth of field emphasizes the drone's insectoid form and aggressive geometry.
